add_new.title: Pilipinas Tourism
add_new.desc:
An interactive 3D travel map of the Philippines. Pick one of ten destinations on the map, from Batanes to Davao, and fly into a 3D tour of it: terrain built from real elevation data, draped with satellite imagery, and dressed with landmarks such as lighthouses, stone houses, churches, boats and reef life. Each place is told in scroll-driven chapters with photos and quick facts, and a travel passport collects a stamp for every destination's question you answer. Python tools bake the elevation, imagery and province outlines ahead of time, so the site runs with no server.

Explore it here:

https://mark00s02.github.io/Pilipinas_Tourism/
